spec_match.rationale: Runs a real oscillator+worklet graph per renderSizeHint with a glitch log; started honestly ('Audio started: renderSizeHint=default, sampleRate=44100') in the driven run.

interactive.rationale: Hint buttons, stress slider, and start/stop drive the live graph and log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised glitch-count comparison lab.

edge_cases.rationale: Glitch logging and hint switching are real, but there is no unsupported-hint labelling tying results to this build's ignored renderSizeHint.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 2 pass / 5 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: Start audio logged the session start with parameters; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables; two raw hex values in the waveform canvas palette.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled controls, but the waveform is canvas-only and the glitch log is not a live region.

openQuestions.title: Note when renderSizeHint is being ignored
openQuestions.detail: On pre-151 builds every hint runs at 128 frames; a one-line 'this browser ignores the hint (Chrome 151+)' note near the hint buttons would stop cross-hint glitch comparisons being read as meaningful here.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: cycled hint buttons and started audio; log recorded 'Audio started: renderSizeHint=default, sampleRate=44100' and the glitch log armed; zero console errors.
